name: bazel_run
description: Run a Bazel command in the repository workspace. Bazel 9.0.1 is in use; only 'bazel mod' is accepted for dependency management — WORKSPACE-based commands are rejected. Examples: 'build //...', 'test //...', 'mod deps', 'mod graph', 'query //apps/...'.

args.description: Space-separated Bazel arguments, e.g. 'build //...' or 'mod deps --depth=1'. Do NOT include the 'bazel' binary name itself.

workspace_root.description: Absolute path to the Bazel workspace root. Defaults to the repo root detected via .bazelversion walk-up.
